title: File:Landscape of Bangladesh.বাংলাদেশের প্রাকৃতিক দৃশ্য.jpg
author: Ashikul Islam Anik
description:
Natural scenery of Bangladesh - A
breathtaking winter dawn sunrise over the misty paddy fields of rural Bangladesh. The vibrant orange-red sun emerges slowly through a thick veil of fog, casting a warm golden glow across the flooded rice paddies. Two majestic trees rise as striking dark silhouettes against the glowing sky, their reflections perfectly mirrored in the calm, glassy water. Fresh green rice seedlings blanket the foreground, while the soft mist envelops the entire scene in a dreamy, ethereal atmosphere. This timeless image beautifully captures the serene soul and poetic charm of the Bangladeshi countryside at first light.
